Container.Name: workout-tracker
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted training log. Imports activities from Intervals.icu, Garmin Connect and raw FIT/GPX/TCX/KML files, then adds the views those services don't: collapsible workout history, route maps and charts, per-sport personal records, gear wear tracking, a race calendar, virtual challenge progress, and CTL/ATL/TSB training load.
Everything runs in this one container — nginx serves the interface and proxies the API to uvicorn internally. All data stays in the mapped appdata folder.
IMPORTANT: the database is SQLite. Point the Data path at a cache-backed location (for example /mnt/cache/appdata/workout-tracker, or an appdata share set to cache-only). SQLite over Unraid's /mnt/user FUSE layer can hit file-locking problems.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds workouts.db and, optionally, challenges_seed.json. Use a cache-backed path — SQLite on the /mnt/user FUSE layer can hit locking issues.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the API runs as. 99 is Unraid's 'nobody'. Leave blank to run as root.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the API runs as. 100 is Unraid's 'users'.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone, used for log timestamps. Workout dates are stored as recorded and grouped using your browser's timezone, so this does not affect the statistics.
